newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: TRI says mulls Thai ventures.
newsitem.headline: TRI says mulls Thai ventures.

text.p: Malaysian telecommunications company Technology Resources Industries Bhd said on Friday it would consider entering the Thai telecommunications market.

"We will consider them," said Tajudin Ramli, chairman of TRI, when asked if he would consider forming strategic alliances with either the Communications Authority of Thailand (CAT) or the Telephone Organisation of Thailand (TOT).
He was speaking to reporters after the company's annual general meeting.
But Ramli added that TRI was currently not in discussions with either company.
CAT and TOT are both state-run telecommunications utilities that are expected to be privatised.
"We don't have to be an equity partner to be a partner," said Ramli, without elaborating.
